name: resvg
category: A4. Vector, typography, diagrams and stills
summary: Rust SVG renderer and command line tool that rasterises static SVG to PNG with consistent, browser-independent output. Supports most of SVG 1.1 and parts of SVG 2, text via system or supplied fonts, and ignores scripts and animation. Its strength is deterministic output from a single fast binary, which makes still frames and card backgrounds reproducible.
use_when: Rasterising static SVG to PNG reproducibly without launching a browser; over Inkscape for speed and determinism
Converting Graphviz, Mermaid or Satori SVG into frames or textures
Fixtures that need a stable hash across runs on the same version
avoid_when: SMIL, CSS animation or script in the SVG: it ignores them, so use a browser capture with Playwright
Heavy filter or foreignObject content: a browser renders those
Raster resizing of photos: libvips or ImageMagick
